summary: Frontend-only retest of Crypto.Invest auth-guard fix and 'Reconectar' round-trip. All 4 requested checks PASSED: (1) hard reload of /crypto-invest/painel keeps admin on the panel, (2) direct URL load of /crypto-invest/sessao/{code} keeps technician on the viewer, (3) viewer sends {type:'request-offer'} on WS onopen and again when Reconectar is clicked; a paired client peer that replies with a fake offer causes the viewer to setRemoteDescription + createAnswer + send {type:'answer'}, and status becomes 'Ligado — a ver o ecrã do cliente', (4) zero console errors during viewer load and reconnect.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext exposes only {user, ready, login, logout}; guards in CryptoInvest.jsx and CryptoInvestViewer.jsx now correctly use `ready` — matches contract.

CryptoInvestViewer.connect() correctly closes prior pc/ws, rebuilds a fresh RTCPeerConnection with re-fetched ICE, and emits {type:'request-offer'} on ws.onopen + on peer-joined(client). Answer/ICE flow verified end-to-end via paired client peer.
Minor: ws.onclose in viewer retries only on connectionstatechange path (auto), not on onclose itself. That's fine because the user can click Reconectar manually. No action needed.
Minor: video element has muted+autoPlay+playsInline — good for autoplay policy. No action needed.
